environment.import_method: saved projects after selecting an installed singer (A13); source reading of USinger/UTrack

expected.summary: Machine-dependent identity materially affects whether BLT should generate projects.

observed.summary: Saved track: singer: alys-db-002-fra (folder name). The installed singers are discovered by scanning the singers directory; the track's singer is looked up by that id (UTrack.OnSingerRefreshed checks SingerManager.Inst.Singers for the id).

classification_note: A track stores the singer as a short string id, 'alys-db-002-fra', which is the voicebank folder name inside the singers directory; no path, no hash, no display name. It resolves only if an equally named singer is installed on that machine. A generator must read the id from the user's installed singers rather than invent it, and must treat a missing singer as an error (a missing singer otherwise renders a silent stem).
